notes.title: Multiple Saves!
notes.content:
You'll notice as soon as you begin the game, you'll have the option to select a save file, which will, after a delay, display what has been accomplished in that save file.

What has already been accomplished should not be wiped, it is the first option.

notes.title: Table Mode Update
notes.content:
Depending on whether or not certain food pellets have been completed and if not, the amount of food pellets that were eaten, will decide how much is visible or able to be picked up while exploring the Table.

All the way from being able to carry a limited number of paperclips and string, to being unable to see how to continue the progression points!

Refining of this to continue and if there's any bugs that appear, let me know!

notes.title: Scientist's Report
notes.content:
[b]Enhancement Project[/b]

[u]Is there a food product which can be made to increase physical and mental abilities?[/u]

Hypothesis..

It's well known that the phrase 'you are what you eat' can be used in many ways, because the body is ingesting and assimilating the majority of what it consumes. This leads to necessary nutrients being distributed throughout an organism. 
But is it possible to create a super-food that makes someone faster, smarter, and stronger just by eating it? 
Most likely, if it was impossible to assist in the development of a body's attributes from eating and drinking, then protein shakes would be obsolete. 

[u]Variables[/u]
Maze scale and complexity
Food Pellets
Water?
Rattus subjects?

[u]Materials[/u]
Too much Cardboard
A lot of blue tape
Other random stuff I found in my basement

[u]Method of Testing[/u]
The subject will be placed within the maze, and the reward button will be scented with something tasty for the subject.
Each time the subject consumes a food pellet successfully, they will be placed in the next maze as it gets progressively larger.
Once the subject has ran the mazes a few times, work on creating a new food pellet with the advantages of the previous pellets.

[u]Current Results[/u]
The subject appears to be benefitting from the food pellets better than I expected, subject takes only a few minutes on average to complete all the mazes.
Health appears optimal.
No irregular behaviors.
Subject is not experiencing sleep deprivation or negative side effects so far.

notes.title: Developer Notes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! It means a lot to me that you're even able to see this in the first place, so here's some things to get hooked on for the future!

Work in progress/in development

Red food pellet experiment
A longer bunch of mazes with a special reward to increase your speed by small amounts so it isn't disruptive.

Layered mazes without hints for where the Button is.
While it is important to allow for natural abilities such as heightened smell, knowing exactly where the button is really takes away from being able to map out the maze in your head and navigate.

The hint for where the button is on the first twelve will remain though, but for the new ones they won't. This is so you generally know what to expect, always going the most convoluted and longest path and all that!

Expecting to get the next update complete by next Friday, I'll keep posting news every weekday.

Between learning more on how unreal engine 5 works and making content, I'll see just how quick I can get you new things to do-hopefully without being super demanding on computers.
